one_line: Chalukya king overseeing copper-plate land grants with his Deccan scribes.

appearance.age_look: Looks around 35–40, tall and lean but athletic, with a poised royal bearing.
appearance.face: Oval face with strong jaw, medium-brown Deccan complexion, straight nose, sharp dark eyes with a calm but focused gaze; a small tilak on the forehead; default expression is composed and thoughtful, often slightly stern when reading charters.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair gathered into a high, smooth knot at the back of the head (kondai-style topknot) wrapped with a narrow golden headband, short side locks curling just over the ears, and a neatly trimmed black moustache without a beard.
appearance.costume: He wears an early-medieval Deccan royal outfit: a knee-length, tightly wrapped off-white cotton dhoti with fine red edge stripes, pleated in front and tucked at the waist, secured by a broad gold cloth belt; upper body in a fitted, short-sleeved light-cream tunic that reaches mid-hip, with subtle woven patterns and a round neckline; over this, a rich deep-red silk uttariya (shawl) with thin gold borders draped over the left shoulder and across the chest; his jewellery is region-appropriate and restrained—broad gold armlets on both upper arms with simple floral motifs, a single flat gold necklace with a central pendant, small round gold earrings close to the ear, and a thin gold bangle on each wrist; he wears simple brown leather sandals, and a small signet ring on his right hand, engraved with a boar emblem referencing the Chalukya seal.
appearance.signature: A rectangular copper plate grant bundle tied with a thin cord and bearing a small attached seal, which he often holds in one hand while the other rests on a slim stylus tucked into his waist-belt.

ref_desc: Vikramaditya I is a medium-brown, sharp-eyed Chalukya king with a black topknot and moustache, wearing an off-white dhoti, light-cream tunic, deep-red silk shawl, gold jewellery and sandals, holding a copper-plate grant bundle with a small seal and stylus.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Vikramaditya I, a Deccan Chalukya king, as a dignified early-medieval ruler: he has an oval face, medium-brown complexion, sharp dark eyes, a small tilak and a neatly trimmed black moustache, with thick black hair gathered into a high smooth topknot wrapped by a narrow golden headband and short side locks over his ears. Dress him in an era-accurate royal outfit: a knee-length, tightly wrapped off-white cotton dhoti with fine red edge stripes, pleated in front and secured by a broad gold cloth belt; a fitted, short-sleeved light-cream tunic reaching mid-hip with subtle woven patterns; and a rich deep-red silk uttariya shawl with thin gold borders draped over his left shoulder and across the chest. Add restrained jewellery: broad gold armlets with simple floral motifs, a flat gold necklace with a central pendant, small round gold earrings, thin gold bangles and a signet ring with a boar emblem, plus simple brown leather sandals. Place a rectangular copper-plate grant bundle tied with a thin cord and a small attached seal in his left hand, while a slim stylus is tucked into his waist-belt near his right hand; keep his default expression composed and thoughtful, and show front, side and back views to emphasize the consistent face, topknot, costume details and deep-red, off-white, gold, light-cream and brown colour palette.
